bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

claim_boundary: STATIC accounting structure. Every component is UNRECORDED or NOT_INSTRUMENTED; none carries a duration. The ladder table states what each rung REQUIRES, which is arithmetic on the target and not a forecast. No Odyssey was launched and no campaign wall is projected.

components.name: acquisition
components.note: fetching a specimen; bounded by network, reusable across campaigns

components.name: census
components.note: indexing a specimen's tensors; deterministic given the bytes

components.name: gravity_search
components.note: the search itself; the largest declared compile term

components.name: kernel_probe
components.note: needs an exclusive GPU lane; cannot overlap another GPU measurement

components.name: gpu_total
components.note: every GPU-exclusive measurement, serialised against itself

components.name: resident_prefill
components.note: prompt/context prefill per turn; the stable-prefix reuse target

components.name: resident_decode
components.note: reasoning and generation; the irreducible cognition this campaign protects

components.name: tool_call_recovery
components.note: malformed call, schema repair, re-probe -- each costs a full resident turn

components.name: context_reconstruction
components.note: rebuilding what the resident already knew; HCLI-owned, consumed not built here

components.name: receipt_generation
components.note: resident cognition spent writing evidence boilerplate

components.name: result_ingestion
components.note: copying numbers between files; deterministic and migratable off the resident

components.name: scheduler_idle
components.note: gaps where a lane waits with nothing admitted; pure loss

components.name: dependency_wait
components.note: a lane blocked on another lane's output; the serial critical path

components.name: failed_hypotheses
components.note: experiments that produce a negative result; useful, not waste

components.name: duplicated_work
components.note: two lanes deriving the same fact; pure loss
